content_sections.body: Say the model in two thought groups: 'That sounds good, but could we meet a little later?' Pause after the first complete idea and stress the word that carries the important information. Then say a new version about responding to an invitation. This supports the goal to use invitation and arrangement chunks with suitable stress.
content_sections.title: Make the message easy to hear (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Partner A begins a realistic exchange about responding to an invitation. Partner B asks for one missing detail. Swap roles and make one change to the time, place, reason, quantity, or next action. Check that the exchange achieves: Use invitation and arrangement chunks with suitable stress.
content_sections.title: Guided dialogue (8 minutes)

content_sections.body: Create a short message about responding to an invitation without reading the model. Include a main event or plan and one precise detail. Speak it once slowly, then once at a natural pace. Listen for whether the key information is clear.
